papers.abstract: 本文提出 AttaCode，用归因引导和带越狱提示的对抗代码生成，攻击漏洞检测模型。公开页面未能读到英文摘要，以上仅按标题概括。

papers.title: How Effectively Do Security Skills Guide Coding Agents in Vulnerability Detection in Linux Kernel?
papers.abstractOneWord: 评测安全技能能否带编码智能体在 Linux 内核上做漏洞检测，用了大模型，对象是 Linux 内核。
papers.abstract: 大语言模型编码智能体（如 Claude Code）越来越多被用来做安全审计，任务相关的技能则提供可复用的漏洞分析流程。但它们在真实漏洞上的检出效果，以及失败原因，仍不清楚。本文对 37 个安全技能做了大规模实证研究：用 Claude Code 搭配 4 个底层大模型，在 10 类共 100 个真实 Linux 内核漏洞上跑了 14800 次。评估覆盖函数、语句和漏洞类别三个层次。结果显示，24.4% 的运行能定位到正确函数，18.3% 能同时找到函数和责任语句，15.7% 能正确分类漏洞。失败分析指出证据获取、状态关系推理、代码理解、候选验证、调查覆盖和报告等方面的不足。据此提出 SKILL-SIF，一个从漏报和失败模式中学习、迭代演化安全技能的自改进框架。用原基准演化 5 个表现最好的技能，再在 100 个未见过的漏洞上评测：完全正确的漏洞检测最多提高 8 倍（从 2% 到 16%），四个大模型的总体准确率提高 1.85 倍（从 6.05% 到 11.20%）。这些结果说明现有安全技能仍有限，也表明用失败驱动技能演化，有望提高编码智能体的漏洞检测能力。
papers.abstractEn: Large language model (LLM) coding agents, such as Claude Code, are increasingly used for security auditing, with task-specific skills providing reusable vulnerability-analysis procedures. However, their effectiveness in detecting real vulnerabilities and the reasons for their failures remain unclear. We conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 37 security skills using Claude Code with four underlying LLMs on 100 real Linux kernel vulnerabilities across ten classes, totaling 14800 runs. We evaluate vulnerability detection at the function, statement, and vulnerability-class levels. Results show that 24.4 percent of runs locate the correct function, 18.3 percent identify both the function and responsible statement, and 15.7 percent correctly classify the vulnerability. Our failure analysis reveals limitations in evidence acquisition, state-relation reasoning, code interpretation, candidate verification, investigation coverage, and reporting. Based on these findings, we propose SKILL-SIF, a self-improving framework that iteratively evolves security skills by learning from missed vulnerabilities and failure patterns. We evolve five top-performing skills using the original benchmark and evaluate them on 100 previously unseen vulnerabilities. SKILL-SIF improves fully correct vulnerability detection by up to eight times (from 2 percent to 16 percent) on unseen vulnerabilities, while aggregate accuracy across four LLMs increases by 1.85 times (from 6.05 percent to 11.20 percent). These findings highlight the limitations of existing security skills and demonstrate the potential of failure-driven skill evolution to improve vulnerability detection in coding agents.

papers.title: SPLASH: Contrastive Audit Pressure for Detecting and Localizing Security Hallucinations in Generated Code
papers.abstractOneWord: 用对比审计压力检测并定位大模型生成代码中的安全幻觉，对象是生成代码。
papers.abstract: 大语言模型生成的代码常常能通过全部功能测试，但仍然不安全。这类安全幻觉很常见，写得也很自信，并会在多次采样中重复出现，因此生成器自身的不确定性或静态分析都很难抓住它们。本文提出 SPLASH，核心是一种称为审计压力的度量：对比同一段生成程序在安全审查和风格审查两种条件下的 teacher-forced 对数概率。把该度量聚合到语句和程序后，再结合相互竞争的编辑的概率模型，SPLASH 就能在候选程序中选出更安全的版本，并定位有漏洞的语句，无需训练模型、无需针对特定 CWE 的规则，也不需要访问生成模型内部。在 12 个模型、899 个任务上生成的 63684 个程序上，SPLASH 有 74% 的情况选出了安全代码，在不安全程序中有 58% 把漏洞语句排在第一，并且优于前沿大模型评判器。
papers.abstractEn: Code generated by large language models often passes every functional test while remaining insecure. These security hallucinations are common, written with high confidence, and repeated across samples, so neither the generator's own uncertainty nor static analyzers reliably catch them. We introduce SPLASH, which is guided by a new measure called audit pressure. It contrasts teacher-forced log-probabilities for the generated program under a security review and a style review. Aggregated to statements and programs, and grounded in a probabilistic model of competing edits, audit pressure allows SPLASH to choose the secure program among a model's candidate programs and locate the vulnerable statement, with no model training, CWE-specific rules, or internal access to the generating model. On 63,684 programs generated by 12 models for 899 tasks, SPLASH picks secure code in 74% of cases, places the vulnerable statement first in 58% of insecure programs, and chooses better than a frontier LLM judge.

papers.title: Locate, Then Reason: End-to-End Patch Presence Testing in Stripped Binaries
papers.abstractOneWord: 先定位再推理，用大模型判断去符号二进制里安全补丁是否存在，对象是去符号二进制。
papers.abstract: 二进制补丁存在性测试（PPT）要判断安全修复是否已经出现在去符号二进制中。已有系统常常假设补丁相关代码已知或已经匹配成功。函数级匹配对编译变化、内联、有限模型上下文和缺失使用上下文都很脆；相似度还会压掉裁决所需的补丁级差异。本文提出 PatchAlign，一套端到端的二进制 PPT 流程：先做大规模定位以提高召回，再根据补丁特有证据做最终裁决。它用指令对齐检索和调用者—被调用者上下文定位补丁相关二进制片段，然后筛选短名单，并用大模型把目标二进制与漏洞版本、已修补版本对照。实验表明，PatchAlign 能在没有目标位置先知的情况下精确定位补丁相关代码并判断补丁状态。
papers.abstractEn: Binary patch presence testing (PPT) determines whether a security fix is present in a stripped binary. Prior systems often assume that patch-relevant code is known or successfully matched. Function-level matching is brittle to compilation changes, inlining, finite model context, and missing usage context; moreover, similarity suppresses the patch-sized distinction needed for the verdict. We present PatchAlign, an end-to-end binary PPT workflow, which performs large-scale localization that maximizes recall economically, then the final verdict reasons for patch-specific evidence. PatchAlign uses instruction-aligned retrieval and caller-callee context to accurately locate patch-relevant binary code pieces, then screens the shortlist and compares target binary code with vulnerable and patched references using an LLM. Our experiments indicate that PatchAlign can precisely localize patch-relevant code and determine patch status without a target-location oracle.

papers.title: Peer Pressure: Execution-Verified Co-Evolution of Attacker and Defender Populations for Code Security
papers.abstractOneWord: 用执行验证共同训练攻击与防御群体，提高大模型代码智能体的漏洞发现，对象是真实代码仓库。
papers.abstract: 大语言模型代码智能体越来越多在缺少监督的情况下直接提交代码，而在静态漏洞数据集上训练的防御方往往跟不上会适应的对手。本文改为共同训练攻击方和防御方，并用执行结果决定每一项奖励：攻击方（Red）编辑真实仓库，只有补丁能应用、能构建、能通过测试、完成开发任务，并在隔离容器中复现真实利用时才得分；利用路径同时标出入口、关键操作以及其间的轨迹。Peer-Relative Policy Optimization（PRPO）让双方都是同一冻结基座上的 LoRA 适配器群体，并按面对相同条件的同角色同伴计分，把群体放进策略梯度基线而不是对手池，再用锦标赛保持多样性。匹配会抵消条件难度：覆盖相同时，相对按其他条件计算的基线可提高 2.3 个百分点的平衡准确率，并在一半验证开销下匹配组内对照。PRPO 的 7B 差异审查器在四个未见应用、三种未训练语言上达到 64.8% 平衡准确率，比监督安全微调高 5.5 个百分点，比冻结的前沿审查器 Claude Opus 4.8 高 4.4 个百分点，在训练过的应用上领先 15.8 个百分点。其 9B 仓库智能体在 172 条留出 VulnGym 公告中找回 23 条，监督微调为 10 条，同一骨架未训练为 7 条；在 43 个可达入口中定位 17 个，而 mini-swe-agent 搭配 GLM-5.2 为 13 个。同一算法原样用于越狱防御时，在相同语料和模型规模下匹配或超过 WildGuard 的静态 F1；在与训练预言机不同的评判器下，把攻击成功率从 36.0% 降到 4.6%，WildGuard 为 8.9%。
papers.abstractEn: LLM code agents increasingly ship code with little oversight, yet defenders trained on static vulnerability datasets fall behind adapting adversaries. We co-train attacker and defender instead, and let execution decide every reward: an attacker (Red) edits a real repository and earns nothing unless its patch applies, builds, passes the tests, completes its development task and reproduces a real exploit in an isolated container, whose path also labels the entry point, the critical operation and the trace between them. Peer-Relative Policy Optimization (PRPO) makes both sides populations of LoRA adapters over one frozen base and credits each against same-role peers that faced an identical condition, placing the population inside the policy-gradient baseline rather than the opponent pool, with a tournament preserving diversity. Matching cancels the condition's difficulty: at equal coverage it is worth 2.3 points of balanced accuracy over a baseline computed on other conditions, and it matches a within-policy control at half the verifier spend. PRPO's 7B diff reviewer reaches 64.8% balanced accuracy on four unseen applications in three untrained languages, 5.5 points above supervised security fine-tuning and 4.4 above a frozen frontier reviewer (Claude Opus 4.8), which it leads by 15.8 on the application it trains on. Its 9B repository agent recovers 23 of 172 held-out VulnGym advisories, against 10 after supervised fine-tuning and 7 for the same backbone untrained under the same scaffold, and locates 17 of 43 reachable entry points against 13 for mini-swe-agent with GLM-5.2. Run unchanged on jailbreak defense, the same algorithm matches or exceeds WildGuard's static F1 at equal corpus and model size. Under a judge distinct from its training oracle it cuts attack success from 36.0% to 4.6%, against WildGuard's 8.9%.

papers.title: Secure Agentic Coding through Counterexample-Grounded Feedback
papers.abstractOneWord: 用反例落地的执行反馈做安全编码验证，避免优化信号却留着漏洞，对象是编码智能体。
papers.abstract: 随着编码模型和智能体框架变强，可靠的安全验证正在成为主要瓶颈。要改进安全代码生成，信号报告的进展必须和优化后的真实程序行为对齐；否则优化器可以只提高信号的判定，而不去掉底层漏洞。现有基于模型的方法要么要求模型从源码推断程序行为，要么要求为对抗测试指定正确结果，给安全信号带来很重的推理负担。本文提出 Falcon，一个以反例为根据地的验证框架：把攻击探索和行为验证分开，再通过被测程序的执行轨迹把两者连起来。在测试时修复中，Falcon 在多个安全代码生成基准上，比其他安全信号带来更强的留出功能—安全收益，同时保持或提高功能性。作为强化学习奖励时，即使所有策略都能优化各自的训练奖励，Falcon 在留出功能—安全上也优于静态分析和学习到的奖励。把 Falcon 与任一代理奖励结合还能进一步提高留出表现，说明执行落地的反馈可以减轻奖励过优化，同时保留现有安全信号的有用引导。
papers.abstractEn: As coding models and agent harnesses become more capable, reliable security verification is becoming a central bottleneck. Improving secure code generation requires a signal whose reported progress remains aligned with actual program behavior under optimization; otherwise, an optimizer can improve the signal's verdict without removing the underlying vulnerability. Existing model-based approaches require models to either infer program behavior from source code or specify correct outcomes for adversarial tests, placing substantial reasoning demands on the security signal. We introduce Falcon, a counterexample-grounded verification framework that separates attack exploration from behavioral verification and connects them through execution traces of the program under test. In test-time repair, Falcon yields substantially stronger held-out functional-security gains than alternative security signals across secure code generation benchmarks, while preserving or improving functionality. As an RL reward, Falcon also outperforms static-analysis and learned rewards on held-out functional-security, even when all policies successfully optimize their respective training rewards. Combining Falcon with either proxy reward further improves held-out performance, suggesting that execution-grounded feedback can mitigate reward overoptimization while preserving useful guidance from existing security signals.

papers.title: CAT-RAG: Improving Secure Code Generation with Category-Aware Agentic Retrieval
papers.abstractOneWord: 用类别感知的智能体检索增强大模型安全代码生成，对象是传统软件代码。
papers.abstract: 大语言模型代码生成进展很快，但安全漏洞仍然普遍；检索增强代码生成（RACG）在检索知识冗长或易被投毒时还会放大风险。现有安全 RACG 往往按细粒度漏洞注入安全知识，当查询涉及多个相关弱点时，会增加提示开销并稀释模型注意力。本文提出 CAT-RAG，一个按安全类别感知检索的智能体框架。它用大模型作为分类智能体做自适应类别选择，既可单独作为安全层，也可直接接到现有 RACG 流水线，无需改底层模型。作者用紧凑、按语言划分的安全类别代替 CWE 级检索。这些类别按共同的安全问题（如输入验证和注入攻击）组织多个 CWE，而不是只做相近条目分组。每个类别把最佳实践和安全代码示例收成一份节省提示的表示。在 CyberSecEval、CodeGuard+ 和 HumanEval 上的评测显示，CAT-RAG 在 CyberSecEval 上把安全代码生成相对现有最优方法的提升几乎翻倍（23.57% 对 12.11%），同时把 token 开销降低 41.71%。
papers.abstractEn: Despite rapid progress in LLM-based code generation, security vulnerabilities remain widespread, and retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) can further amplify risk when retrieved knowledge is verbose or vulnerable to poisoning. Existing secure RACG approaches inject security knowledge at a fine-grained vulnerability level, causing prompt overhead and diluted model attention when a query implicates multiple related weaknesses. We propose CAT-RAG, an agentic security category-aware retrieval-augmented code generation framework. CAT-RAG performs adaptive category selection via an LLM as a categorizer agent and operates either as a standalone security layer or as a drop-in add-on to RACG pipelines, requiring no modification to the underlying model. We replace CWE-level retrieval with compact, language-specific security categories. These categories provide a higher-level abstraction over individual CWE weaknesses, organizing them by the security concern they share, such as Input Validation and Injection Attacks, rather than merely grouping related entries. Each category consolidates best practices and secure code examples into a single, prompt-efficient representation. We perform a comprehensive evaluation across CyberSecEval, CodeGuard+, and HumanEval. On CyberSecEval, CAT-RAG nearly doubles the secure code generation improvement over the state of the art (23.57% vs. 12.11%) while reducing token overhead by 41.71%.

papers.title: Narratives Mislead: An Empirical Study of How LLMs Misjudge CVSS Severity in Bug Bounty Reports
papers.abstractOneWord: 实证研究大模型如何在漏洞赏金报告上误判 CVSS 严重度，对象是漏洞赏金报告。
papers.abstract: 漏洞赏金平台收到报告的速度超过厂商分诊能力，人们越来越多考虑用大语言模型给驱动优先级的 CVSS 严重度打分。已有评测多用短 CVE 描述并只报告准确率，但落地更取决于模型怎样错，而不仅是错多少。CVSS 给每个指标规定了形式含义，这和研究者在叙述性报告里描述影响的方式并不一致；模型理由也提示错误会集中在两者分叉处。本文从 Huntr 和 HackerOne 挖出 4281 份已公开报告，做成 240 份带厂商验证 CVSS 向量的 Huntr 基准，并在四种提示策略和微调下评测 8 个大模型，按严重度级别和分数统计错误，再在单份报告上分析子向量。最好的提示配置级别准确率只有 49.58%，比总是预测多数级别只高 10 个百分点；微调 7B 模型最多提到 56.25%，这还是偏乐观的上界。错误有方向：高估远多于低估，而且几乎认不出低严重度漏洞。作者把错误追到规范划出、叙述报告却模糊的三条语义边界：潜在影响与已实现影响、影响幅度与授权范围、不确定性与最坏情况。因为违规部分来自报告本身，文末做了探索性案例：在四份报告上，一种对齐边界、不含利用的报告结构，能在叙述暗示未声称的账户接管时压低前沿模型分数，但报告未说清的指标仍保持开放；四份里有三份的两个已公布标签并不一致。
papers.abstractEn: Bug bounty platforms receive vulnerability reports faster than vendors can triage them, and Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for assigning the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) severity that drives prioritization. Prior evaluations score short CVE descriptions and report accuracy, but deployment depends on how models err, not only how often. CVSS gives each metric a formal meaning that departs from how researchers describe impact in narrative reports, and model rationales suggest that errors concentrate where the two diverge; we ask whether this pattern is systematic. From 4,281 publicly disclosed reports mined from Huntr and HackerOne, we build a benchmark of 240 Huntr reports with vendor-validated CVSS vectors and evaluate eight LLMs under four prompting strategies and fine-tuning, measuring errors by severity class and score and analysing sub-vectors on individual reports. The best prompting configuration reaches only 49.58% level accuracy, ten points above always predicting the majority level, and fine-tuning a 7B model raises this to at most 56.25%, an optimistic upper bound. Errors are directional: models overestimate far more often than they underestimate, and they almost never recognize low-severity vulnerabilities. We trace these errors to three semantic boundaries that the specification draws and narrative reports blur: potential versus realized impact, impact magnitude versus authorization scope, and uncertainty versus the worst case. Because the violations originate partly in the report, we close with an exploratory case study: on four reports, a boundary-aligned, exploit-free report structure lowered a frontier model's score where the narrative invited an unclaimed account takeover, but left the metrics a report does not settle open, and the two published labels disagreed on three of the four reports.

papers.title: Follow Your Money: Real-Time Transaction Tracking in Blockchain Trading Systems

papers.abstract: 本文研究区块链交易系统中的实时资金追踪。公开页面未能读到英文摘要，以上仅按标题概括。

papers.title: Empirical Analysis of TEE-Enabled Rollup Designs
papers.abstractOneWord: 实证比较 TEE 加固的 rollup 排序器设计，关注审查和 MEV，无 LLM，对象是以太坊 L2。
papers.abstract: 二层 rollup 已成为以太坊的主要扩容方案。其核心是 rollup 排序器：负责排序、执行并把 L2 交易块提交到以太坊主链。排序器中心化会带来安全风险，包括审查，以及通过操纵交易抽取最大可提取价值（MEV）。可信执行环境（TEE）能为代码和数据提供硬件强制的机密性和完整性，因此是加强排序器安全、保证可验证中立的候选方案。但 TEE 设计可以有多种，在模块化、性能和安全保证之间取舍不同。其中，把提议者和构建者逻辑（PBS）拆成独立服务，是相对把全部排序逻辑捆在一起的单体方案的有力竞争者。已有若干理论框架，却缺少把 TEE 接入 rollup 排序器的实用性与安全权衡的实验评估。本文在 PBS 和单体排序器两种模型下，对 TEE 加固的 rollup 设计做了系统实证研究。实验表明，TEE 对 rollup 性能的影响很小，PBS 也不会明显放大这一影响；PBS 还可能通过更专门、更高效的构建者实现带来显著性能提升。
papers.abstractEn: Layer 2 (L2) rollups have become the dominant scaling solution in Ethereum. At the core of these systems lies the rollup sequencer, a component that orders, executes, and submits L2 transaction blocks to the main Ethereum blockchain. The centralization of this sequencer introduces security risks, including censorship and malicious manipulation of transactions to extract maximum extractable value (MEV). Trusted execution environments (TEEs) provide strong hardware-enforced confidentiality and integrity guarantees for code and data. TEEs are strong candidates for strengthening security and ensuring verifiable neutrality in rollup sequencer operations, but multiple TEE-based designs are possible, offering different trade-offs among modularity, performance, and security guarantees. Among them, the separation of proposer and builder logic (PBS) into independent services is a strong contender against the monolithic approach that bundles all sequencer logic. Despite several proposed theoretical frameworks, there is a lack of experimental evaluation of the practicality and security trade-offs of integrating TEEs into rollup sequencers. This work addresses this gap through a comprehensive empirical study of TEE-enabled rollup designs under both PBS and monolithic sequencer models. Our experimental evaluations show that the impact of TEEs on rollup performance is small and that PBS does not significantly amplify it. We also show that PBS can lead to significant performance improvements by enabling more specialized, efficient builder logic implementations.

papers.title: On the (In)stability of Adaptive Fee Mechanisms in Multi-Chain Systems
papers.abstractOneWord: 分析多链系统里自适应手续费机制的稳定性风险并提出协议层缓解，无 LLM，对象是跨链手续费市场。
papers.abstract: EIP-1559 已成为无许可区块链中占主导的交易费机制，用自适应基础费调节稀缺区块空间。它在需求波动响应和长期资源使用稳定之间取舍。单链上这一权衡已被理解，经验上也较稳定。但在多链系统中，跨链流量会在原本独立的费用市场之间引入延迟的经济交互，改变控制动态并带来现有模型未覆盖的稳定风险。已部署系统已经分化：Polkadot 采用保守更新率，实际上关掉了费用自适应，退回低效的第一价格拍卖；Cosmos 采用激进更新率却没有形式保证。为填补这一空白，本文提出控制论框架，把多链费用市场形式化为带延迟反馈的非线性动力系统，并指出延迟放大的过校正是不稳定的结构根源。实验表明，跨链耦合会相对单体链侵蚀稳定性，把基础费更新率的安全参数空间最多缩小 84.8%。不稳定还会在链之间传播，污染本来稳定的对等链。在以太坊的更新率下，单体链仍稳定，多链系统却出现满块与近空块之间的极端负载振荡，超过一半的块处于满容量。主流 Cosmos 链在默认配置下已超出安全边界，由此带来的负载振荡使出块失败率提高一个数量级。据此，作者设计了一种轻量协议层缓解，去掉过校正并在多链环境中稳定动态。
papers.abstractEn: EIP-1559 has become the dominant transaction fee mechanism in permissionless blockchains, regulating scarce block space through an adaptive base fee. The design balances a trade-off between responsiveness to demand fluctuations and stability of long-term resource usage. On a single chain, this trade-off is well understood and empirically stable. In multi-chain systems, however, cross-chain flows introduce delayed economic interactions across otherwise independent fee markets. These interactions alter the control dynamics and create stability risks that existing models do not capture. Deployed systems have already polarized. Polkadot enforces conservative update rates, effectively disabling fee adaptivity and reverting the market to inefficient first-price auctions. Cosmos adopts aggressive update rates without formal guarantees. To fill this gap, we propose a control-theoretic framework that formalizes multi-chain fee markets as a nonlinear dynamical system with delayed feedback. We identify delay-amplified over-correction as the structural root of instability. Experiments show that cross-chain coupling erodes stability relative to monolithic blockchains, reducing the safe parameter space for base fee update rates by up to 84.8%. Moreover, instability propagates across chains, contaminating the otherwise stable peer chains. At Ethereum's update rate, which leaves a monolithic chain stable, the multi-chain system exhibits extreme load oscillation between full and near-empty blocks, with over half of all blocks at full capacity. Mainstream Cosmos chains already exceed their safe bounds under their default configurations, and the resulting load oscillation raises their block failure rate by an order of magnitude. Guided by this mechanism, we design a lightweight protocol-level mitigation that removes the over-correction and stabilizes dynamics in multi-chain environments.

papers.title: Aerie: Efficient Aggregation of Falcon Signatures
papers.abstractOneWord: 用格上 SNARK 聚合 Falcon 签名，服务区块链验证者投票，无 LLM，对象是以太坊验证者签名。
papers.abstract: NIST 选出的后量子签名比它们要替换的椭圆曲线签名大十倍到一百多倍。而且，与区块链用来聚合验证者投票的 BLS 签名不同，它们不能原生聚合。这两个问题都可以用 SNARK 处理：用一份短证明说明一批签名有效，从而替换这些签名本身。当前主流、也是以太坊路线图核心的做法，是把基于哈希的签名和基于哈希的 SNARK 配对。这很慢，因为证明者必须为每个签名证明很多次哈希计算。本文改为用格上 SNARK 聚合格上签名，提出 Aerie，用于聚合 Falcon-512 和 Falcon-1024 签名。通过在聚合中保留每份签名的短随机盐，Aerie 让验证者直接计算哈希，证明只覆盖代数检查和范数检查。Aerie 把针对这些检查的协议与 Akita 多项式承诺结合起来。与已有 Falcon 聚合方案不同，它还证明签名满足 Falcon 的字节格式要求。在没有 GPU 加速的 Apple M4 Max 笔记本上，Aerie 在 0.65 秒内聚合 32768 个 Falcon-512 签名，大约相当于以太坊一个槽的验证者投票数。一份证明覆盖整批，无需递归。聚合结果含盐时约为每签名 42.1 字节；若签名共享一个盐，总计约 66 KiB。单核验证 54 毫秒，比逐个检查签名快 10 倍。单核证明时间大约只是逐个验证的 8 倍。作者在经典随机预言机模型中证明 Aerie 的知识可靠性，并由 Falcon 的安全性导出聚合不可伪造性。
papers.abstractEn: The post-quantum signatures selected by NIST are ten to over a hundred times larger than the elliptic-curve signatures they replace. Moreover, unlike the BLS signatures that blockchains use to aggregate validator votes, they do not aggregate natively. Both problems can be addressed with a SNARK: a short proof that a batch of signatures is valid, replacing the signatures themselves. The prevailing approach, central to Ethereum's roadmap, pairs hash-based signatures with hash-based SNARKs. This is slow because the prover must prove many hash evaluations per signature. We instead aggregate lattice-based signatures with a lattice-based SNARK. We present Aerie, a proof system for aggregating Falcon-512 and Falcon-1024 signatures. By retaining each signature's short random salt in the aggregate, Aerie lets the verifier compute the hashes directly. The proof then covers only algebraic and norm checks. Aerie combines protocols tailored to these checks with the Akita polynomial commitment scheme. Unlike prior Falcon aggregation schemes, it also proves that the signatures satisfy Falcon's byte-format requirements. On an Apple M4 Max laptop without GPU acceleration, Aerie aggregates 32,768 Falcon-512 signatures, roughly the number of validator votes in one Ethereum slot, in 0.65 seconds. A single proof covers the whole batch, with no recursion. The aggregate is 42.1 bytes per signature including the salts, or about 66 KiB in total if the signatures share one salt. It verifies in 54 milliseconds on one core, 10× faster than checking the signatures individually. On one core, proving takes only about 8× as long as individual verification. We prove knowledge soundness of Aerie in the classical random-oracle model and derive aggregate unforgeability from Falcon's security.
